title: Start the TUI when colour capabilities are uncertain
purpose: Waffles reports Tom’s Ghostty TERM was refused on the 205. On 9 September 2026 at 14:07 and 14:09 Melbourne, Waffles ruled: start, degrade, explain once; never refuse over colour.
task: Replace the colour admission gate with explicit rendering depth. Keep cursor/raw-mode I/O failures real. No extra subprocess or startup probe. Checked source evidence and unrun live-terminal limits are recorded in [PROOF.md](../PROOF.md).

requirements.title: Progressive colour from startup through every renderer
requirements.spec: WHEN extended colour is unconfirmed THEN Norn SHALL retain its interactive TUI and render using 16 ANSI colours or default colours, with one in-interface notice. Recognized modern TERM suffixes SHALL support indexed colour without a terminfo requirement.
acceptance: xterm-ghostty, xterm-kitty, alacritty and wezterm start without COLORTERM
Explicit truecolor/24bit COLORTERM wins; otherwise unknown TERM degrades to ANSI16 and unset, empty or dumb TERM uses default colours
No colour-only fallback into print mode
Retained transcript foreground/background and Iridium composer obey the same depth
Selection and tool emphasis remain visible without custom colours
Strict workspace Clippy, fmt, focused tests and venue review before landing
